elaine (docs): Drafting release notes for the Persistent KV cache + SDK snippet changes. Putting a PR up in ~10m; need sample sync and link checks. Also planning a short migration guide for teams that pin model versions. Ping if you want to review. :wave:

matt (eng): Thanks — will review. quick Q: do we explicitly call out the new cache TTL default? I thought we moved it to 48h.

elaine (docs): Yes, add a bullet under 'Behavior changes' — default TTL now 48h. Also note on rollback: clients pinned to v1 keep previous behavior.

samir (eng-ml): Heads-up — embedding batch API signature changed in the SDK snippet. I have a small patch. Suggest we use this snippet in the migration guide:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
import os
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['RW_API_KEY'])
resp = client.embeddings.create(model='rw-embed-2', input=['a', 'b'], batch_size=16)
print(len(resp.data))
```

elaine (docs): Great — can you PR that snippet to the docs site? Put it under /docs/guides/migrations and link from the release notes.

docs-bot: link-checker found 3 broken links in the release notes draft: one internal anchor, two external (model hub). See /tmp/link_report_1798765432.txt

jordan (qa): I'll run the snippet in the integration env; tag me when PR is up. Also confirm we add a known-issue about cache eviction with long-running streams (seen in nightly tests).

matt (eng): I'll double-check AMI packaging; if packaging changes, we need to mention Dedicated rolling restart window in the notes.

elaine (docs): Plan: I'll open PR with draft notes + migration guide; add 'known issues' referencing the stream eviction. @samir please open snippet PR; @jordan QA to confirm. Target merge EOD tomorrow.

samir (eng-ml): Opening snippet PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/472 — includes the embedding snippet and a short note about batch_size tradeoffs.

elaine (docs): Added TODOs in PR for link fixes and screenshot refresh. Also added a small sample showing fallback routing policy config to the examples section:
```yaml
routing:
  default: low-latency
  fallbacks:
    - region: us-west
      models: ['rw-small-quant']
```

deploy-bot: Deploy preview generated at https://deploy-previews.redwood.ai/1798765432 — warnings: 2 image size warnings.

jordan (qa): Preview looks good. Found one copy nit: 'throughput' typo on the bullet under Performance. Also the sample config needs a short comment about latency implications.

elaine (docs): Fixed typo, added comment on latency, and updated the screenshot references. Merged the release notes PR and the migration guide. Thanks all :tada:

matt (eng): Nice work — I'll follow up in the Dedicated runbook about restart window.

samir (eng-ml): Verified snippet works in staging with batch_size=16, no regressions.

jordan (qa): Marking integration checks green.

elaine (docs): Closing this thread. Will file a small follow-up for localization sync (intl team).
